source: EXPLICITLY NOT A HARDWARE CALIBRATION. The exposure bounds are widened from the provisional e-CAM37M_CUONX / IMX900 development profile to 100us-50000us so that longer-shutter imaging can be studied in software. Reference exposure, gain law, photon/read-noise terms, response curve and black/saturation levels are copied unchanged from imx900_provisional.json and remain unmeasured. Do not cite any result from this profile as a real-camera measurement.
